what_happened: Task description names the existing hook as living in FormalSystem/Semantics/IntTransfer.lean; FrameOver.mem_HF_iff_adjacent is actually declared at FormalSystem/Semantics/IntNormalForm.lean:348. IntTransfer.lean exists but does not contain it. Research proceeded against the real location.

Task description calls the clause 'Possible Worlds' and asserts it DEPENDS on the Totality clause. The paper's recorded-sentinel text names it 'Total Histories', and its proof consumes the chain union plus cor:occurrence only -- Totality is never invoked. The dependency claim is inaccurate; the real dependency is on a total-domain chain union (available canonically) and on hF_nonempty for the closing tail.

app:presheaf-dictionary is absent from the live paper tex entirely -- no label, no commented block, no % SECTION CUT marker. The clause statement and its proof were recovered from the paper repo at commit 94f850f6, which is exactly the sentinel HEAD pinned in docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md, so provenance is the recorded one.

The entire clause -- both maps, compatibility, task-respect, totality, both round trips, the Equiv, and the nonempty tail -- compiled green under lean_run_code within three probe iterations, with no sorry. Measured choice-free ([propext, Quot.sound]) once two simpa calls are replaced by explicit rwa; the only Classical.choice is in the nonempty tail via hF_nonempty. Implementation is de-risked to bookkeeping.

The research report and its saved probe name the forward map 'ofWorld' in namespace FormalSystem.Semantics.Presheaf, but Presheaf/Directed.lean:234 already declares Presheaf.ofWorld (the cut of a world to [0,l]); transcribing the probe verbatim would be a duplicate-declaration error once both modules sit in the root closure. The probe could not see this because it lives in its own Probe566 namespace. Plan resolves it by namespacing the limit's maps under Lim (Lim.ofWorld / Lim.toWorld) and pinning the renamed signatures in the Lean Challenge Statements.

Compiling the Lean Challenge Statements at plan time via lean_run_code (22 sorry-bodied declarations, once with the module's import list and once with Presheaf.Directed added) caught two things before implementation: the ofWorld name collision, and that the probe's read_eq/readAt_def shape does not type-check as a sorry-pinned statement because (absObj t).val no longer reduces to |t| with a sorry body. Restating read_eq over |t| <= x.val (the paper's own phrasing) and leaving readAt_def unpinned fixed both at zero errors on the second attempt; this would otherwise have surfaced as a Phase 2 blocker or a signature-drift finding.
Phase 1 of the Total Histories module transcribed from the verified probe and built green on the first scoped build (restrictTr_central closed by rfl as the plan predicted; no fallback needed).

Phase 1 commit was blocked by the pre-commit typst-sync gate: adding Worlds.lean moves the live file/line counts in typst/generated/status.typ, which the plan's shared-touch list did not name alongside the two aggregators and the three regenerated README inventory blocks (FormalSystem/README.md and the root README.md were also rewritten by --emit-inventory and were not in the plan's file list). Fixed inline with scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix and staged with the phase commit.

Phase 3 (both round trips, worldsEquiv, lim_nonempty) compiled on the first scoped build, and the lean_verify / #print axioms sweep over all 23 declarations reproduced the report's profile exactly: everything on the isomorphism path at [propext, Quot.sound] (twice at [propext]), lim_nonempty alone at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. The two simpa prohibitions and the canonical-window route held the clause choice-free as planned.
